_README: Hand-placed region times. AUTHORITY: this file wins over anything the
re-derive computes, and tools/prep_exhibit_data.py applies it LAST and
never rewrites it. Keep it in the repository even though the payload is
generated — it is authored data, not a build product.
Plus 'reveal': the annotations whose per-recording notes ANSWER their question,
shown behind a peel-off card under ?reveal=peel (editorial, 2026-10-23).
Plus 'sectionLabels': the score sections' English names, by MEI xml:id (they
win over an MEI @label), and 'sectionShort': a short name shared by every
section of a recurring theme, so the ribbon shows it coming back. Both are
DRAFTS (2026-11-17) for the user and Chanda to rule on; lyric incipits stay
in German, as the tunes' own names.
